days.title: Where Species Belong
days.learning_objective: Drawing captures images and ideas on surfaces.
learning_objectives: Identify and utilize basic shapes (circles, squares, triangles) in drawing.
Apply shading techniques to create depth and dimension.
Draw a simple still life using observational skills.

days.title: Why Animals Travel
days.learning_objective: Painting uses color to create visual experiences.
learning_objectives: Identify primary, secondary, and tertiary colors.
Demonstrate basic painting techniques, such as blending and layering.
Create a painting that effectively uses color to convey mood or emotion.

days.title: Shaping Three Dimensions
days.learning_objective: Sculpture creates three-dimensional art from various materials.
learning_objectives: Identify and describe various sculpture materials (clay, wood, metal, etc.).
Demonstrate basic sculpting techniques like modeling, carving, and assembling.
Create a simple sculpture using chosen materials and techniques.

days.title: Putting Pictures on Surfaces
days.learning_objective: Photography captures moments in time with light.
learning_objectives: Explain how a camera captures an image using light.
Identify and adjust basic camera settings like ISO, aperture, and shutter speed.
Apply composition techniques such as the rule of thirds to create visually appealing photographs.

days.title: Thinking With Lines
days.learning_objective: Dance expresses emotion and story through movement.
learning_objectives: Students will be able to identify three different emotions and express them through dance.
Students will be able to create a short dance sequence that tells a simple story.
Students will be able to recognize at least two different cultural styles of dance.

days.title: Why Every Culture Dances
days.learning_objective: Theater brings stories to life through performance.
learning_objectives: Students will be able to identify key elements of a theatrical performance.
Students will be able to develop and portray a unique character through voice and movement.
Students will be able to collaboratively create and perform a short scene.

days.title: Pretending on Purpose
days.learning_objective: Poetry uses language rhythmically to evoke emotion and meaning.
learning_objectives: Identify and describe the key elements of poetry, including rhythm, rhyme, and imagery.
Analyze and interpret the meaning and emotion conveyed in various poems.
Compose original poems using different poetic techniques and forms.

days.title: Words That Sound Like Music
days.learning_objective: Novels tell extended stories that explore human experience.
learning_objectives: Identify key elements of a novel, including plot, character, setting, and theme.
Analyze the author's use of literary devices such as metaphor, simile, and symbolism.
Evaluate the impact of historical and cultural context on a novel's meaning.

days.title: Buildings That Tell Stories
days.learning_objective: Comics combine words and images to tell stories.
learning_objectives: Identify the key elements of a comic book page (panels, speech bubbles, characters, settings).
Develop a short story idea with a clear beginning, middle, and end.
Create a 4-6 panel comic strip using basic drawing techniques and dialogue.

days.title: What Clothes Communicate
days.learning_objective: Animation brings drawings and models to life through movement.
learning_objectives: Define animation and its core principles (persistence of vision).
Create a simple flipbook animation demonstrating basic movement.
Experiment with stop-motion animation using everyday objects.

days.title: Why Play Matters
days.learning_objective: Film combines visual storytelling with sound and motion.
learning_objectives: Define key elements of film (visuals, sound, motion).
Identify different film genres and their conventions.
Create a basic storyboard for a short film scene.

days.title: Why We Compete
days.learning_objective: Instruments create music through vibration and resonance.
learning_objectives: Identify at least three different types of musical instruments.
Explain how vibration creates sound in musical instruments.
Describe the role of resonance in amplifying sound.
Conduct a simple experiment to demonstrate vibration.
Distinguish between different sound qualities (pitch, volume).

days.title: The Beat in Everything
days.learning_objective: Rhythm organizes sound and movement in time.
learning_objectives: Identify rhythmic patterns in music and nature.
Create simple rhythmic compositions using body percussion and instruments.
Explain how rhythm organizes sound and movement in time.

days.title: Why Notes Make Tunes
days.learning_objective: Melody is a sequence of notes that creates a musical phrase.
learning_objectives: Students will be able to define melody and its role in music.
Students will be able to identify ascending, descending, and static melodic contours.
Students will be able to create a short melody using a given set of notes.
Students will be able to analyze and compare melodies from different genres of music.

days.title: When Sounds Agree
days.learning_objective: Harmony occurs when multiple notes sound pleasing together.
learning_objectives: Define harmony and explain its importance in music.
Identify consonant and dissonant intervals.
Recognize basic chord structures (major, minor).
Create simple harmonic progressions.

days.title: Machines That Make Music
days.learning_objective: Singing uses the human voice as a musical instrument.
learning_objectives: Students will be able to identify and demonstrate proper vocal posture.
Students will be able to match pitch accurately on simple melodies.
Students will be able to understand and apply basic breathing techniques for singing.

days.title: Your Voice as an Instrument
days.learning_objective: Drums create rhythm and have been used across all cultures.
learning_objectives: Identify at least three different types of drums and their cultural origins.
Explain how the size and material of a drum affects its sound.
Create a simple rhythmic pattern using drums or percussion instruments.
Demonstrate an understanding of the universal role of drums in human culture.

days.title: Making What Doesn't Exist
days.learning_objective: String instruments produce sound through vibrating strings.
learning_objectives: Identify string instruments and their components.
Explain how string vibration creates sound waves.
Describe the relationship between string tension, length, and pitch.

days.title: Finding What Was Already There
days.learning_objective: Wind instruments create sound by vibrating air columns.
learning_objectives: Identify different types of wind instruments (brass, woodwind).
Explain how wind instruments create sound through vibrating air columns.
Describe the relationship between air column length and pitch.

days.title: Going Where No One Has Been
days.learning_objective: Shapes are the basic forms that make up our visual world.
learning_objectives: Identify and name basic shapes (circle, square, triangle, rectangle).
Describe the attributes of each shape (number of sides, angles).
Find examples of shapes in everyday objects and the environment.

days.title: The Shape With No Corners
days.learning_objective: Circles are perfectly round and have no corners.
learning_objectives: Identify and describe the properties of a circle (radius, diameter, circumference).
Differentiate circles from other geometric shapes based on their characteristics.
Apply knowledge of circles to solve simple real-world problems.

days.title: The Strongest Shape
days.learning_objective: Triangles are the strongest shape in construction.
learning_objectives: Identify triangles within various structures and designs.
Explain why triangles are inherently strong and stable.
Build a simple triangular structure demonstrating its load-bearing capacity.

days.title: Shapes That Tile Perfectly
days.learning_objective: Squares have four equal sides and four right angles.
learning_objectives: Students will be able to define a square by identifying its four equal sides and four right angles.
Students will be able to differentiate squares from other quadrilaterals (e.g., rectangles, rhombuses).
Students will be able to construct squares using various tools and materials.

days.title: When Two Sides Match
days.learning_objective: Symmetry creates balance through mirrored or repeated patterns.
learning_objectives: Identify lines of symmetry in 2D shapes and real-world objects.
Create symmetrical designs using folding, cutting, and drawing techniques.
Explain the concept of symmetry and its importance in art, nature, and mathematics.

days.title: Making Flat Things Look Deep
days.learning_objective: Perspective creates the illusion of depth on flat surfaces.
learning_objectives: Students will be able to define perspective and its role in creating depth.
Students will be able to identify and draw one-point and two-point perspective.
Students will be able to apply perspective techniques to create realistic landscapes and objects.

days.title: How Things Feel to Touch
days.learning_objective: Texture is how surfaces feel or appear to feel.
learning_objectives: Identify and name at least five different types of textures.
Explain how texture affects how we perceive objects.
Create artwork that incorporates various textures using different materials.

days.title: What's Beyond Earth
days.learning_objective: Space is the area around and between objects.
learning_objectives: Define 'space' as the area surrounding and separating objects.
Identify examples of 'space' in everyday environments and in the universe.
Explain the importance of 'space' in the context of planetary orbits and galaxy formations.

days.title: Big and Small Are Relative
days.learning_objective: Composition arranges elements to create effective designs.
learning_objectives: Define the key principles of composition, including balance, contrast, rhythm, and emphasis.
Apply compositional techniques to arrange elements effectively in a given space.
Analyze existing designs and artworks to identify and evaluate the use of compositional elements.

days.title: Why Difference Catches Your Eye
days.learning_objective: Contrast creates visual interest through differences.
learning_objectives: Identify different types of contrast (light/dark, color, size, texture).
Apply contrast effectively in a visual composition.
Explain how contrast creates visual interest and emphasis.

days.title: How Hot and Cold Work
days.learning_objective: Problem solving finds solutions to challenges and obstacles.
learning_objectives: Identify and define a problem clearly.
Brainstorm multiple potential solutions.
Evaluate the pros and cons of each solution.
Select and implement the best solution.
Reflect on the outcome and learn from the experience.
